findings: Home, objects, and descriptions overlaps earlier topic boundaries.
Reading, Signs & Forms mixes a channel with several communicative purposes.
Simple Communication absorbs distinct social, repair, mediation, and language-control evidence.
Cross-cutting support should not be forced into standalone topical units.

clusters.title: Identity and personal information
clusters.goal: Exchange and record basic personal information.

clusters.title: People and relationships
clusters.goal: Talk about family, friends, known people, jobs, and possessions.

clusters.title: Routines, time, and leisure
clusters.goal: Understand and express routines, schedules, interests, abilities, and weather.

clusters.title: Home, objects, and descriptions
clusters.goal: Locate and describe familiar homes, objects, pictures, and surroundings.

clusters.title: Places, directions, and travel
clusters.goal: Understand and manage basic locations, routes, transport, and travel details.

clusters.title: Food, shopping, and services
clusters.goal: Handle immediate needs, prices, purchases, food, and basic services.

clusters.title: Messages, signs, and forms
clusters.goal: Understand or produce practical notices, messages, correspondence, and forms.

clusters.title: Social contact and collaboration
clusters.goal: Use basic politeness, feelings, reactions, and collaborative exchanges.

clusters.title: Communication strategies
clusters.goal: Repair, relay, translate, and facilitate meaning across candidate units.

clusters.title: Language foundations
clusters.goal: Support intelligible comprehension and control across candidate units.
